{{dablink|For the chapter in ''[[Lord of Chaos]]'' and the [[inn]] that go by another name for the crown, see ''[[Lord of Chaos/Chapter 43|The Crown of Roses]]'' and [[The Crown of Roses]].}}
The '''Rose Crown of Andor''' is the crown worn by the [[Queen of Andor]]. It is a wreath of highly-wrought golden roses. A simplified version is worn by the [[Daughter-Heir]].
